name: Old Post Gardens

location.label: Bloomington Community Farmers' Market (Saturdays), Showers Common, 401 N. Morton St., Bloomington, IN
location.map_query: Showers Common, 401 N Morton St, Bloomington, IN 47404

tagline: Strawberries, tomatoes, broccoli and potatoes — grown the natural way.
about: Jim Lewis always wanted to be a farmer. On 1.5 acres of his wife's family land he grows all kinds of produce, starting plants in a hoophouse and using plant-based compost. He follows organic regulations but isn't certified. Jim has sold at the Bloomington Community Farmers' Market for 15 years, April through October.
highlights: All-natural growing, following organic rules (not certified)
Accepts Farmers' Market gift certificates and Market Bucks
At both the Saturday and Tuesday markets

services.name: Greens & more
services.description: Lettuce, spinach, peas, beets, carrots, radishes, cucumbers, green beans and summer squash.
